categories.label: Moderation & Safety
categories.description: Keep the server safe with moderation tools, automatic filters, audit logs and member verification.

categories.label: Community
categories.description: Greet members, hand out roles and run the features your community uses every day.

categories.label: Levels & Economy
categories.description: Reward activity with XP, achievements, coins and games.

categories.label: Content & Utilities
categories.description: Custom commands, automations, scheduled messages, feeds and other handy tools.

moderation.label: Moderation
moderation.description: Ban, kick, timeout and warn with case history and escalation.

subToggles.label: DM members when punished
subToggles.description: Members get a direct message when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

fields.label: Moderation log channel
fields.description: Every case (warn, timeout, kick, ban, ...) is posted here, even while the Audit Logs module is off. Empty turns case logging off.

fields.label: DM members when punished
fields.description: Members get a direct message when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

fields.label: Command visibility
fields.description: Who sees the confirmation of a moderation command.

fields.label: Moderator roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles can use the bot's moderator commands.

fields.label: Immune roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles are never punished by the bot or by Auto-Moderation.

fields.label: Mute role
fields.description: Used for mutes longer than 28 days (Discord timeouts cover the rest). /modconfig muterole setup:true creates one and locks it out of every channel.

fields.label: Warning escalation
fields.description: Punishes a member automatically once they collect a number of warnings (optionally within a time window).

itemFields.label: Warnings
itemFields.description: How many warnings trigger this step.

itemFields.label: Within (seconds)
itemFields.description: Only warnings from this many seconds count. Empty counts every warning.

itemFields.label: Duration (seconds)
itemFields.description: Required for Timeout (at most 28 days) and Temporary ban; optional for Mute; not used for Kick and Ban.

automod.label: Auto-Moderation
automod.description: Automatically removes or punishes bad words, spam, invites, links, caps, mass mentions and more.

groups.title: Bad words
groups.description: Removes or punishes messages with words you do not want in the server.

fields.label: Bad Words
fields.description: Removes messages that contain a listed word, phrase or pattern.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Bad words and phrases
fields.description: Whole words or phrases, matched case-insensitively (also through spacing and markdown tricks).

fields.label: Bad word patterns
fields.description: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for words the list cannot catch. Unsafe or catch-all patterns are refused.

fields.label: Server Invites
fields.description: Catches invite links to other Discord servers.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: External Links
fields.description: Catches links that are blocked, or not allowed when no domain is blocked.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Blocked domains
fields.description: Links to these sites are caught. While this list is empty, every link outside the allowed domains is caught.

fields.label: Allowed domains
fields.description: Links to these sites are always fine. Adding a domain to one list takes it off the other.

fields.label: Anti-Spam
fields.description: Catches members who send messages too fast.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 3 to 30 messages within 5 s.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Repeated Text
fields.description: Catches the same message sent over and over.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 2 to 20 identical messages within 30 s.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Caps
fields.description: Catches messages that are mostly capital letters.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 50 to 100 % capitals, messages with at least 10 letters.
fields.unit: % capitals, messages with at least 10 letters

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Emojis
fields.description: Catches messages with too many emojis.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 1 to 50 emojis.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Spoilers
fields.description: Catches messages with too many spoiler tags or spoiler attachments.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 1 to 50 spoilers.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Mentions
fields.description: Catches messages that ping too many members or roles.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 2 to 50 mentions.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Zalgo
fields.description: Catches glitch text with piles of combining marks.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 3 to 20 stacked combining marks.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

groups.title: Honeypot
groups.description: Works even while every rule is off, and an exempt channel does not shield it.

fields.label: Honeypot channels
fields.description: Trap channels nobody should type in. Spam bots and hacked accounts post everywhere, so whoever posts in one is punished at once. Staff and exempt roles are never caught. /automod honeypot add can create the channel and post a warning in it.

fields.label: Action
fields.description: Softban and ban also delete their messages from the last day in every channel.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

groups.title: Exemptions
groups.description: Staff (moderators, Manage Messages and immune roles) are always exempt.

fields.label: Exempt roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles are never checked by any rule.

fields.label: Exempt channels
fields.description: Messages in these channels (or categories) are never checked.

logging.label: Audit Logs
logging.description: Posts message, member, voice, channel, role and server events to your log channels.

groups.title: Log channels
groups.description: Each kind of event goes to its own channel. Empty turns that kind off.

fields.label: Message log
fields.description: Deleted, edited and bulk-deleted messages, and posted invites.

fields.label: Member log
fields.description: Role, nickname, avatar and timeout changes, bans and unbans.

fields.label: Server log
fields.description: Channels, threads, roles, emojis, invites and server edits.

fields.label: Voice log
fields.description: Members joining, leaving and switching voice channels.

fields.label: Joins & leaves log
fields.description: Members joining and leaving the server.

fields.label: Logged events
fields.description: Checked events are logged. Unchecked ones are not.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Message events in these channels are never logged. A category covers its channels and threads.

captcha.label: Verification
captcha.description: New members solve a captcha before they get access; those who never verify can be kicked.

groups.title: Verification
groups.description: Post or move the verification panel with /captcha setup or /captcha channel in Discord.

fields.label: Verified role
fields.description: Given to members who pass. It cannot be a moderator, immune or mute role.

fields.label: Required roles
fields.description: Members need any one of these before Verify works (a Linked Role fits). Empty means no requirement. Pick the fallback form with /captcha require in Discord.

fields.label: Captcha type
fields.description: Image: type the code from a picture. Button: one click.

fields.label: Kick unverified members after (minutes)
fields.description: 0 never kicks; otherwise 5 to 10080 minutes (7 days). Setting 0 cancels the kicks already scheduled.

groups.title: Verification panel
groups.description: The message with the Verify button. Saving here also updates the posted panel.

fields.label: Panel message

embed.title: 🛡️ Verification required
embed.description:
Welcome to **{server}**!

To make sure you are human, press **Verify** below. Once you pass, you get access to the rest of the server.

footer.text: Only you can see your captcha.

fields.description: Text, embed and link buttons of the panel. {user} tokens stay as they are: the panel has no member.

fields.label: Verify button
fields.description: Label and colour of the button that starts the verification.

antiraid.label: Anti-Raid
antiraid.description: Spots join floods and brand-new accounts, pauses invites and alerts your moderators.

subToggles.label: Pause invites
subToggles.description: Pauses every invite while the lockdown lasts (the bot needs Manage Server).

subToggles.label: Lock chat
subToggles.description: Takes Send Messages from @everyone while the lockdown lasts and gives it back afterwards (the bot needs Manage Roles).

groups.title: Raid detection
groups.description: A raid is this many joins within this many seconds.

fields.label: Joins
fields.description: How many joins in the window count as a raid.

fields.label: Window
fields.description: The window the joins are counted in.

fields.label: Members who join during a raid
fields.description: What happens to members who join while a raid lockdown lasts.

fields.label: Alert channel
fields.description: Raid alerts go here. Empty uses the moderation log channel.

groups.title: Lockdown
groups.description: What the bot does while a raid lasts. /antiraid lockdown starts or ends one by hand.

fields.label: Pause invites
fields.description: Pauses every invite while the lockdown lasts (the bot needs Manage Server).

fields.label: Lock chat
fields.description: Takes Send Messages from @everyone while the lockdown lasts and gives it back afterwards (the bot needs Manage Roles).

fields.label: Lockdown length
fields.description: The lockdown lifts itself after this long.

fields.label: Minimum account age
fields.description: Accounts younger than this get the action below. 0 = off.

fields.label: Action for new accounts
fields.description: What happens to accounts younger than the minimum age when they join.

rolepersist.label: Role Persistence
rolepersist.description: Gives members their roles and nickname back when they leave and rejoin.

subToggles.label: Give back nicknames
subToggles.description: Also restores the nickname a member had when they left.

groups.title: Role persistence
groups.description: Roles with powerful permissions, managed roles and roles above the bot are never given back.

fields.label: Give back nicknames
fields.description: Also restores the nickname a member had when they left.

fields.label: Never give back
fields.description: These roles are not saved when a member leaves.

fields.label: Keep for
fields.description: Saved roles of members who left longer ago than this are dropped.

backups.label: Server Backups
backups.description: Saves your roles, channels and permissions, and rebuilds what a raid or a mistake deleted.

groups.title: Automatic backups
groups.description: Make, restore and download backups with /backup. Only the server owner can restore or delete a backup.

fields.label: Back up every
fields.description: Hours between automatic backups. 0 = off.

fields.label: Automatic backups kept
fields.description: When a new automatic backup would go over this, the oldest one is deleted.

welcome.label: Welcome & Goodbye
welcome.description: Greets new members with a message, a welcome card or a DM, says goodbye and gives autoroles.

subToggles.label: Welcome message in a channel
subToggles.description: Posts the welcome message in the welcome channel when someone joins.

subToggles.label: Welcome message as an embed
subToggles.description: Sends the channel welcome as an embed; off sends plain text.

subToggles.label: Welcome DM
subToggles.description: Also sends new members a private welcome message.

subToggles.label: Welcome card in the DM
subToggles.description: Attaches the welcome card image to the welcome DM.

subToggles.label: Goodbye message
subToggles.description: Posts a message in the goodbye channel when a member leaves.

subToggles.label: Goodbye message as an embed
subToggles.description: Sends the goodbye message as an embed; off sends plain text.

groups.title: Welcome message
groups.description: Posted in a channel when someone joins.

fields.label: Welcome message in a channel
fields.description: Posts the welcome message in the welcome channel when someone joins.

fields.label: Welcome channel
fields.description: Where the welcome message and card are posted.

fields.label: Welcome message as an embed
fields.description: Sends the channel welcome as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Message text
fields.description: The text line (pings work here). Leave it empty to send only the embed.

fields.label: Embed
fields.description: Shown when "Welcome message as an embed" is on. Clear it to use the default embed.

default.title: 👋 Welcome to {server}!
default.description: You are our **{server.member_count.ordinal}** member. Enjoy your stay!

groups.title: Welcome card
groups.description: An image with the member's avatar and name, attached to the welcome message.

fields.label: Welcome card
fields.description: Whether the card is sent, and its colours and background.

fields.label: Send a welcome card
fields.description: Attaches the welcome card image to the welcome message.

fields.label: Background colour
fields.description: Empty uses the default background.

fields.label: Background image
fields.description: An http(s) link to a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (at most 5 MB). The bot downloads it once to check it.

fields.label: Overlay opacity
fields.description: How much the background image is darkened (0 to 1). Empty uses the default.

groups.title: Welcome DM
groups.description: A private message to every new member.

fields.label: Welcome DM
fields.description: Also sends new members a private welcome message.

fields.label: DM text
fields.description: Leave it empty to send only the embed.
fields.default: Have a great time here in **{server}**!

fields.label: DM embed
fields.description: Optional. Clear it to send the text only.

fields.label: Welcome card in the DM
fields.description: Attaches the welcome card image to the welcome DM.

groups.title: Goodbye message
groups.description: Posted in a channel when a member leaves.

fields.label: Goodbye message
fields.description: Posts a message in the goodbye channel when a member leaves.

fields.label: Goodbye channel
fields.description: Where the goodbye message is posted.

fields.label: Goodbye message as an embed
fields.description: Sends the goodbye message as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Message text
fields.description: The text line. Leave it empty to send only the embed.

fields.label: Embed
fields.description: Shown when "Goodbye message as an embed" is on. Clear it to use the default embed.

groups.title: Autoroles
groups.description: Roles every new member gets.

fields.label: Autoroles
fields.description: Given to every member who joins (after verification and Rules Screening). Roles must be below the bot's highest role.

fields.label: Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Wait this long after the join before giving the autoroles (0 = immediately, at most 7 days). Members already waiting keep their time.

reactionroles.label: Reaction Roles
reactionroles.description: Members pick their own roles from buttons, a dropdown or emoji reactions.

invites.label: Invite Tracker
invites.description: Tracks who invited whom, with an invite leaderboard and personal invite links.

tickets.label: Ticketing
tickets.description: Support ticket panels with categories, staff claiming and HTML transcripts.

tempvoice.label: Temporary Channels
tempvoice.description: Join-to-create voice channels that their owners can lock, rename and resize.

stats.label: Statistics Channels
stats.description: Channel names that count members, bots, online members, boosts and more.

fields.label: Category for new stat channels
fields.description: New statistics channels are created in this category (the bot needs Manage Channels there). Empty creates them at the top.

birthdays.label: Birthdays
birthdays.description: Members save their birthday and the bot announces it, with an optional birthday role.

subToggles.label: Require birth year
subToggles.description: Members must include the year when they save their birthday.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Where birthdays are announced. Empty turns announcements off.

fields.label: Announcement hour
fields.description: The hour (0-23) in the server time zone when birthdays are announced.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Used when the birth year is unknown. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Message with age
fields.description: Used when the birth year is known. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Birthday role
fields.description: Given for the member's birthday and removed the next day. Changing it here does not take the old role off members celebrating today; /birthday config role in Discord does.

fields.label: Require birth year
fields.description: Members must include the year when they save their birthday.

polls.label: Polls
polls.description: Single or multiple choice polls with live results and an end time.

giveaways.label: Giveaways
giveaways.description: Button-entry giveaways with role requirements, weighted odds, rerolls and XP or coin prizes.

starboard.label: Starboards
starboard.description: Reposts popular messages to a showcase channel once they collect enough reactions.

suggestions.label: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Members post ideas everyone can vote on; staff approve, deny or mark them implemented.

subToggles.label: Open a thread on each suggestion
subToggles.description: Starts a discussion thread on every new suggestion (the bot needs Create Public Threads).

subToggles.label: Allow anonymous suggestions
subToggles.description: Members may hide their name on a suggestion. Staff can still look up who wrote it.

subToggles.label: DM the author on review
subToggles.description: The author gets a direct message when staff approve, deny or otherwise update their suggestion.

groups.title: Suggestions
groups.description: /suggestion submit posts here; members vote with the buttons and staff review with /suggestion.

fields.label: Suggestion channel
fields.description: New suggestions are posted here with voting buttons.

fields.label: Open a thread on each suggestion
fields.description: Starts a discussion thread on every new suggestion (the bot needs Create Public Threads).

fields.label: Allow anonymous suggestions
fields.description: Members may hide their name on a suggestion. Staff can still look up who wrote it.

fields.label: DM the author on review
fields.description: The author gets a direct message when staff approve, deny or otherwise update their suggestion.

fields.label: Cooldown between suggestions
fields.description: Seconds a member waits between two suggestions. 0 = no cooldown.

modmail.label: Modmail
modmail.description: Members DM the bot to reach staff privately; each conversation becomes a staff thread.

subToggles.label: Anonymous staff replies
subToggles.description: Replies reach the member as "Staff" instead of the name of the staff member.

groups.title: Modmail
groups.description: Members DM the bot; each conversation opens a thread in the staff channel. Block members with /modmail block.

fields.label: Staff channel
fields.description: Conversations open as threads here. Keep it hidden from members; the bot needs Create Private Threads.

fields.label: Roles to ping
fields.description: Pinged in the new thread when a conversation opens.

fields.label: Greeting
fields.description: Sent to the member when their conversation opens.
fields.default: Thanks for your message! The staff of **{server}** will answer you here soon.

fields.label: Anonymous staff replies
fields.description: Replies reach the member as "Staff" instead of the name of the staff member.

applications.label: Applications
applications.description: Forms for staff or role applications, reviewed with Accept and Deny buttons.

events.label: Events
events.description: Schedule server events with Going and Maybe buttons, reminders and an attendee role.

subToggles.label: Also create a Discord event
subToggles.description: Adds each event to the Events list of the server too (the bot needs Manage Events).

subToggles.label: Create channels for events
subToggles.description: A text chat when the event is created and a voice channel before it starts. When the event is over and the voice channel is empty, both are deleted, along with the event post and its reminders.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Where /event create posts. Empty posts in the channel the command runs in.

fields.label: Also create a Discord event
fields.description: Adds each event to the Events list of the server too (the bot needs Manage Events).

fields.label: Reminder
fields.description: Minutes before the start to ping members who are going. 0 = no reminder.

groups.title: Event channels
groups.description: Private text and voice channels for each new event. Only members who answer Going or Maybe, the host and administrators can see them. The bot needs Manage Channels and Manage Roles.

fields.label: Create channels for events
fields.description: A text chat when the event is created and a voice channel before it starts. When the event is over and the voice channel is empty, both are deleted, along with the event post and its reminders.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Where the channels go. Empty uses a category called Events and makes it if needed.

fields.label: Open the voice channel early
fields.description: Minutes before the start. 0 = at the start.

afk.label: AFK
afk.description: Members set an AFK note; whoever mentions them sees it, and it clears when they are back.

subToggles.label: Add [AFK] to nicknames
subToggles.description: Puts "[AFK] " in front of the nickname while a member is AFK (the bot needs Manage Nicknames).

groups.title: AFK
groups.description: Members go AFK with /afk set; it clears on their next message.

fields.label: Add [AFK] to nicknames
fields.description: Puts "[AFK] " in front of the nickname while a member is AFK (the bot needs Manage Nicknames).

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Messages here neither end an AFK nor answer mentions of AFK members. A category covers its channels.

boosts.label: Server Boosts
boosts.description: Thanks members who boost the server and lets boosters make a role of their own.

subToggles.label: Let boosters make their own role
subToggles.description: Boosters can create a role with their own name, colour and icon (the bot needs Manage Roles).

fields.label: Thank-you channel
fields.description: A thank-you is posted here when a member boosts the server. Empty = none.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Posted when a member starts boosting.
fields.default: 💎 {user} just boosted **{server}**! Thank you! We now have {boosts} boosts.

groups.title: Booster roles
groups.description: Boosters make a role of their own with /boost role. Booster roles never get any permissions.

fields.label: Let boosters make their own role
fields.description: Boosters can create a role with their own name, colour and icon (the bot needs Manage Roles).

fields.label: Place booster roles below
fields.description: Booster roles go just below this role. Empty = just above the Nitro Booster role (or at the bottom), so moderators keep power over boosters.

fields.label: Keep the role after a boost ends
fields.description: Days a member keeps their role after they stop boosting. 0 = removed at once.

confessions.label: Confessions
confessions.description: Members post anonymously; staff can review confessions before they appear.

subToggles.label: Allow an image
subToggles.description: Members may attach one image to a confession.

subToggles.label: Refuse links
subToggles.description: Confessions that contain a link are refused.

groups.title: Confessions
groups.description: Members confess with /confession submit. Staff never see who wrote one; only admins can reveal an author with /confession reveal, and that is written to the moderation log.

fields.label: Confession channel
fields.description: Confessions are posted here.

fields.label: Review channel
fields.description: Confessions wait here for a moderator to approve them. Empty = posted at once. Keep it hidden from members.

fields.label: Allow an image
fields.description: Members may attach one image to a confession.

fields.label: Refuse links
fields.description: Confessions that contain a link are refused.

fields.label: Cooldown between confessions
fields.description: Seconds a member waits between two confessions. 0 = no cooldown.

voiceroles.label: Voice Roles
voiceroles.description: Gives members a role while they are in a voice channel.

subToggles.label: None in the AFK channel
subToggles.description: Members in the server's AFK channel get no voice roles.

groups.title: Voice roles
groups.description: Use roles made only for this: the bot takes them away from anyone who is not in a linked voice channel.

fields.label: Channel roles
fields.description: Members in the channel, or in any voice channel of the category, have the role.

fields.label: Roles for any voice channel
fields.description: Members in any voice channel of the server have these roles.

fields.label: None in the AFK channel
fields.description: Members in the server's AFK channel get no voice roles.

leveling.label: Levels
leveling.description: Members earn XP for chatting and voice time, level up and unlock reward roles.

subToggles.label: Voice XP
subToggles.description: Members also earn XP for time spent in voice channels (not while alone, muted or AFK). Switching it off drops open voice sessions without credit.

subToggles.label: Level-up message as an embed
subToggles.description: Sends level-up announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

subToggles.label: Keep lower reward roles
subToggles.description: Members keep earlier reward roles when they earn a higher one; off keeps only the highest.

subToggles.label: Remove rewards on XP loss
subToggles.description: Members who lose XP also lose the reward roles above their new level.

groups.title: XP
groups.description: Members earn a random amount of XP per message, at most once per cooldown.

fields.label: Minimum XP per message
fields.description: MEE6 uses 15.

fields.label: Maximum XP per message
fields.description: MEE6 uses 25. Must be at least the minimum.

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: Messages within this time after the last rewarded one earn nothing.

fields.label: Server XP multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies every XP gain (0.1 to 10).

fields.label: Announce level-ups
fields.description: Where the level-up message goes.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Used when "Custom channel" is selected.

fields.label: Level-up message as an embed
fields.description: Sends level-up announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Level-up message
fields.description: Empty uses the default message.
fields.default: GG {player}, you just advanced to level {level}!

fields.label: Voice XP
fields.description: Members also earn XP for time spent in voice channels (not while alone, muted or AFK). Switching it off drops open voice sessions without credit.

fields.label: XP per minute in voice
fields.description: How much XP a minute in voice is worth.

fields.label: No-XP roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles earn no XP.

fields.label: No-XP channels
fields.description: No XP is earned in these channels, their threads, or the channels of a listed category.

groups.title: Role rewards behaviour
groups.description: Pick the reward roles themselves in the list below. Run /levelconfig role sync in Discord to apply a change to every member.

fields.label: Keep lower reward roles
fields.description: Members keep earlier reward roles when they earn a higher one; off keeps only the highest.

fields.label: Remove rewards on XP loss
fields.description: Members who lose XP also lose the reward roles above their new level.

fields.label: XP boost roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles earn more XP; the highest multiplier applies.

groups.title: Rank card
groups.description: The look of the /rank card.

fields.label: Rank card
fields.description: Colours and background of the /rank card.

fields.label: Background image
fields.description: An http(s) link to an image (at most 8 MB). The bot downloads it once to check it.

fields.label: Overlay opacity
fields.description: How much the background image is darkened (0 to 0.9).

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.description: Tiered achievements for messages, reactions, levels, boosts and purchases, with rewards.

subToggles.label: Announcement as an embed
subToggles.description: Sends achievement unlock announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

groups.title: Unlock announcements
groups.description: Create and edit the achievements themselves in the list below.

fields.label: Announce unlocks
fields.description: Where unlocks are announced. Boosts and purchases have no channel of their own and use the announcement channel.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Used by "Custom channel", and for unlocks that happen outside a channel.

fields.label: Announcement as an embed
fields.description: Sends achievement unlock announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Announcement message
fields.description: Empty uses the default message.

economy.label: Economy
economy.description: A wallet per server with daily rewards, work, payments, a shop and casino games.

subToggles.label: Copy the legacy global balance
subToggles.description: New accounts start once with the member's balance from the old global wallet.

fields.label: Currency name
fields.description: Shown after every amount, e.g. "250 coins".
fields.patternMessage: Use letters, numbers, spaces and simple punctuation only (no markdown, mentions or newlines).

fields.label: Currency emoji
fields.description: A standard emoji or a custom emoji of this server.

fields.label: Starting balance
fields.description: What a brand-new account starts with. At most the maximum balance.

fields.label: Maximum balance
fields.description: No account can hold more. Lowering it also lowers every balance above the new maximum.

fields.label: Maximum bet
fields.description: The highest bet of a casino game. 0 = no limit beyond the balance.

fields.label: Maximum winnings
fields.description: The highest net win of one casino game. 0 = no limit.

fields.label: Copy the legacy global balance
fields.description: New accounts start once with the member's balance from the old global wallet.

fields.label: Minimum daily reward
fields.description: The smallest /daily payout.

fields.label: Maximum daily reward
fields.description: The largest /daily payout. At least the minimum.

fields.label: Minimum work pay
fields.description: The smallest /work payout.

fields.label: Maximum work pay
fields.description: The largest /work payout. At least the minimum.

fields.label: Work cooldown (minutes)
fields.description: How long a member waits between two /work.

fields.label: Casino games are allowed
fields.description: With an empty list the games work everywhere.

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Threads count as their parent channel.

games.label: Games
games.description: Rock-paper-scissors, number guessing, tic-tac-toe and two-player Scrabble.

counting.label: Counting
counting.description: A channel where members count up from 1 in turns; a wrong number starts the count again.

groups.title: Counting channel
groups.description: A new channel starts from 1 at the next count. /counting set in Discord also posts the rules there.

fields.label: Counting channel
fields.description: Members count up here, one number per message.

customcommands.label: Custom Commands
customcommands.description: Your own !commands and /tag replies, plus keyword auto-responders.

subToggles.label: Auto-responder triggers
subToggles.description: Replies automatically when a message matches one of your triggers (needs the Custom Commands module on).

fields.label: Auto-responder triggers
fields.description: Replies automatically when a message matches one of your triggers (needs the Custom Commands module on).

automations.label: Automations
automations.description: When-If-Do rules that react to messages, reactions, voice activity, joins and threads.

embeds.label: Embed Messages
embeds.description: Build, save, publish and edit rich embed messages with fields and link buttons.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Scheduled channel messages at a time of day, on an interval or once, in the server's time zone.

feeds.label: Social Feeds
feeds.description: Posts new RSS, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky and podcast items to a channel.

translation.label: Auto-Translate
translation.description: Translates a channel's messages into up to five languages.

search.label: Search Anything
search.description: Look up anime, manga, Pokémon and Urban Dictionary definitions.

subToggles.label: /search urban only in age-restricted channels
subToggles.description: Urban Dictionary lookups only work in age-restricted channels.

fields.label: /search urban only in age-restricted channels
fields.description: Urban Dictionary lookups only work in age-restricted channels.

liverole.label: Live Role
liverole.description: Gives members a role while they stream. Switching it off here leaves it on current streamers; /liverole disable in Discord removes it too.

groups.title: Live role
groups.description: Changes here apply as members start or stop streaming. /liverole set and require in Discord also update current streamers at once.

fields.label: Live role
fields.description: Given while a member streams. Use a role only the bot hands out: members without a stream lose it.

fields.label: Only for members with
fields.description: Only members with this role get the live role. Empty = everyone who streams.

groups.title: Go-live posts
groups.description: Posted when a member goes live and gets the live role, at most once an hour per member. Only the ping role is notified.

fields.label: Post channel
fields.description: Where go-live posts go. Empty turns them off.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: {url} is the stream link. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned at the start of each post. It only pings if the role is mentionable or the bot has Mention Everyone.

autotime.label: Auto Timestamps
autotime.description: Answers times typed in chat, like "fri 5pm", with a timestamp everyone sees in their own timezone.

groups.title: Ignored channels
groups.description: Times are read in the zone of the member who typed them: their own (/timezone set) or their timezone role.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Times typed in these channels are never answered. A category covers its channels and threads.

sticky.label: Sticky Messages
sticky.description: Keeps a message at the bottom of a channel, posting it again as chat moves on.

autothreads.label: Auto Threads
autothreads.description: Opens a thread on every message in chosen channels and publishes announcement posts.

groups.title: Auto threads
groups.description: Every member message in these channels gets its own thread (the bot needs Create Public Threads).

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Thread names may use {user} (display name), {content} (the start of the message), {channel} and {date}.

itemFields.label: Close button
itemFields.description: Posts a button in each thread that its starter or a moderator can use to close it.

fields.label: Announcement channels
fields.description: New posts here, by members, bots or webhooks, are published to the servers that follow the channel (the bot needs Manage Messages). Discord allows 10 per channel per hour; the rest stay unpublished.

bumps.label: Bump Reminders
bumps.description: Reminds the server to bump it on Disboard when the cooldown ends, and counts who bumps.

subToggles.label: Thank the bumper
subToggles.description: Replies with a thank-you right after a successful bump.

groups.title: Bump reminders
groups.description: Works with Disboard: the bot sees each successful /bump and reminds the server when it can bump again.

fields.label: Reminder channel
fields.description: Reminders are posted here. Empty = the channel of the last bump.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Pinged with each reminder. Empty = no ping.

fields.label: Reminder message
fields.description: Posted when the server can be bumped again.
fields.default: 📣 The server can be bumped again! Use `/bump` to keep us near the top of Disboard.

fields.label: Thank the bumper
fields.description: Replies with a thank-you right after a successful bump.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Sent after each successful bump.
fields.default: 📣 Thanks for bumping, {user}! The next bump is possible {next}.

fields.label: Coins per bump
fields.description: Coins given for each bump while Economy is on. 0 = none.

general.title: General
general.description: Time zone, embed colour and the custom command prefix: settings every module uses.

groups.title: Server settings
groups.description: Settings every module uses.

fields.label: Time zone
fields.description: Used for reminders, birthdays and every other schedule. Changes apply from the next run of each schedule.

fields.label: Embed colour
fields.description: Colour of the bot's informational embeds. Empty uses the default blurple.

fields.label: Custom command prefix
fields.description: Members run custom commands as <prefix>name, e.g. !rules. Empty (or "off") turns prefix commands off; /tag use still works.
fields.patternMessage: The prefix can be at most 5 characters, without spaces or any of ` < > @ # : \ /.

groups.title: Timezone roles
groups.description: Roles such as @CST that give members a time zone in /timestamp (/settings timezone-role).

fields.label: Timezone roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles get its time zone in /timestamp, unless they saved their own with /timezone set; with several, the highest role wins. Hand the roles out with a Unique reaction-role panel.

embeds.label: Saved embeds
embeds.description: Build messages with an embed and link buttons, post them in any channel and edit the posted message whenever you like. Saved embeds are shared with /embed and the Automations module.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short unique name for this embed, also used by /embed in Discord. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: The text, embed and link buttons. Variables like {server} are filled in when the message is posted; {user} is you. Saving changes also updates the posted message.

readOnly.label: Status
readOnly.description: Draft, or posted in a channel.

readOnly.label: Channel
readOnly.description: Where the message is posted (for a draft: where it was last posted).

actions.label: Post in a channel
actions.description: Posts the message in a channel. If it is already posted, the new copy becomes the one that is kept up to date.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: A text or announcement channel the bot can post in.

fields.label: Delete the previous copy
fields.description: When the embed is already posted somewhere, delete that message (move it). Off: the old message stays but is no longer updated.

actions.label: Update posted message
actions.description: Applies the saved message to the posted copy again, e.g. after the server name changed or a missing permission was fixed.

actions.label: Delete posted message
actions.description: Deletes the posted message from Discord. The saved embed stays as a draft you can post again.
actions.confirm: Delete the posted message from Discord? The saved embed stays as a draft.

tags.label: Custom commands
tags.description: Commands members run with the server prefix (!name) or /tag use: replies with random variations, DMs, messages to other channels and roles to give or take, with access rules and cooldowns.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Members type it after the prefix, e.g. rules for !rules. Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in /help and /tag list.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the command does not answer.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: What the command does, in order (up to 5). Replies support variables and arguments such as {1}.

itemFields.label: Replies
itemFields.description: Reply, DM and send actions: one of these is picked at random each time.

itemFields.label: Reply
itemFields.description: Up to 2,000 characters, or 4,000 when sent as an embed.

itemFields.label: Send as an embed
itemFields.description: Reply, DM and send actions only.

itemFields.label: Channel
itemFields.description: "Send to a channel" only: where the message goes.

itemFields.label: Role
itemFields.description: Role actions only. It must be below the bot's highest role and carry no moderator permissions.

itemFields.label: Roles the message may ping
itemFields.description: Reply and send actions: role mentions in the text only ping these roles. DMs never ping.

responses.text: Hello {user}!

fields.label: Allowed roles
fields.description: Only members with one of these roles may use it. Empty: everyone.

fields.label: Denied roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles may not use it.

fields.label: Allowed channels
fields.description: Only works in these channels or categories. Empty: everywhere.

fields.label: Denied channels
fields.description: Never works in these channels or categories.

fields.label: Cooldown length
fields.description: How long before it can be used again (up to 365 days).

fields.label: Delete the !name message
fields.description: Deletes the member's message after the command ran (prefix use only; the bot needs Manage Messages).

triggers.label: Auto-responders
triggers.description: Automatic replies to messages that contain a keyword or match a pattern. They answer while the Custom Commands module and its auto-responder switch are on.

fields.label: Keyword or pattern
fields.description: The word, phrase or regular expression to watch for.

fields.label: Response
fields.description: The reply. Variables such as {user} and {channel} work.

fields.label: Cooldown per member
fields.description: How long one member waits before it answers them again (0 = no cooldown).

fields.label: Delete the matching message
fields.description: The bot needs Manage Messages for this.

fields.label: Only in these channels
fields.description: Empty: every channel. Threads count as their parent channel.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, the settings are kept.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Messages the bot posts on a schedule: at a time of day, every few minutes or hours, or once. Times of day use the server time zone from the General settings.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short unique name, also used by /reminder in Discord. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the reminder is posted.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Server and channel variables work. Reminders have no member, so {user} variables are posted as written.

fields.label: Time of day
fields.description: "At a time of day": when it is posted, in the server time zone.

fields.label: Days
fields.description: "At a time of day" and "Every interval": the days it runs on. None selected: every day.

fields.label: Interval
fields.description: "Every interval": time between posts, 5 minutes to 7 days (10080 minutes).

fields.label: Daily start
fields.description: "Every interval": only post from this time of day (needs an interval under 24 hours). Empty: from midnight.

fields.label: Daily stop
fields.description: "Every interval": stop posting at this time of day. Empty: until midnight.

fields.label: Date and time
fields.description: "Once": when it is posted (within one year).

fields.label: Skip when the channel is quiet
fields.description: Not posted unless someone chatted since the last reminder (not for "Once").

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned at the start of every reminder.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, nothing is posted.

actions.label: Send a test
actions.description: Posts the reminder once now as a preview. Roles are not pinged and the schedule is not touched.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where to post the test. Empty: the reminder's channel.

feeds.label: Social feeds
feeds.description: Post new RSS items, YouTube uploads, Reddit posts, Bluesky posts and podcast episodes in a channel. Each feed is checked every 5 to 30 minutes; only items published after it was added are posted.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: RSS: the feed URL or a site that links to its feed. YouTube: the UC… channel ID or a youtube.com/channel/UC… link (@handles are not supported). Reddit: the subreddit, e.g. r/aww. Bluesky: a handle, profile link or DID. Podcast: its name to search for, or its RSS feed URL. It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where new items are posted.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned with every new item.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Empty: the default message for this kind of feed. Variables: {title} {link} {author} {feed}, plus {youtube_channel} (YouTube), {subreddit} (Reddit), {bluesky_name} {bluesky_handle} (Bluesky), {podcast_title} {episode_title} (podcasts). Feeds have no member, so {user} variables do not work.

fields.label: Include reposts
fields.description: Bluesky only: also post reposts.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, the settings are kept. Turning it back on resets its failures; items published while it was off are skipped.

actions.label: Check now
actions.description: Fetches the feed once and shows its newest item. Nothing is posted or changed.

levelRoles.label: Level rewards
levelRoles.description: Roles members earn when they reach a level. Adding a reward does not give the role to members who are already past that level: run /levelconfig role sync in Discord for that. Members who already have a role keep it when you remove its reward. Whether lower rewards are kept is set under "Keep lower reward roles".

fields.label: Level
fields.description: Members get the role as soon as they reach this level. Each level has one reward.

fields.label: Reward role
fields.description: The role the bot gives. It must be below the bot's highest role, and each role can be the reward for one level only.

readOnly.label: Reward
readOnly.description: The level this reward is for.

shopItems.label: Shop items
shopItems.description: What members can buy with /shop buy. Deleting an item also deletes every copy members own. Role items need a role the bot can give (it must be below the bot's highest role).

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in /shop and used to pick the item. Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Price
fields.description: What one copy costs, in the server currency.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Collectible items just sit in the inventory. Usable items are used with /use. Role items give a role.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: The role a Role item gives. Only for Role items; it must be below the bot's highest role.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in the shop.

fields.label: Image link
fields.description: A picture shown with the item (an http or https link).

fields.label: Use on purchase
fields.description: The item is used the moment it is bought. Not for collectible items.

fields.label: Used up on use
fields.description: Each use removes one copy from the inventory.

fields.label: Allow several copies
fields.description: Members may own more than one copy (up to the limit below). Off: one per member.

fields.label: Copies per member
fields.description: The most copies one member may own.

fields.label: Stock
fields.description: Copies left for sale. Empty means unlimited; 0 means sold out.

fields.label: Purchase message
fields.description: Shown after a purchase. Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: Use message
fields.description: Shown after the item is used. Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: In the shop
fields.description: Off hides the item from /shop and stops purchases. Copies members own are kept.

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.description: Goals members work towards (messages, reactions, levels, boosts, purchases), with up to four tiers and rewards. Deleting an achievement deletes every member's progress on it; roles, XP and coins already given are kept. The bot picks up changes within about 30 seconds.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short text shown in /achievements.

fields.label: Badge
fields.description: One emoji shown next to the name. Empty uses the default badge of the trigger. A custom emoji must come from a server the bot is in.

fields.label: What members do
fields.description: What counts as progress. Cannot be changed later. Level achievements need the Levels module, purchase achievements the Economy module.

fields.label: Tiers
fields.description: Up to four goals, lowest first: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond. Members unlock a tier when they reach its goal and get its rewards. Tiers are matched by position when you change them: removing the last tier keeps rewards already given, and members who already passed a lowered goal unlock it with their next activity.

itemFields.label: Goal
itemFields.description: What a member has to reach for this tier. Goals go up from tier to tier.

itemFields.label: Give this role
itemFields.description: Reward: a role the bot gives. It must be below the bot's highest role.

itemFields.label: Take this role away
itemFields.description: Reward: a role the bot removes. It must be below the bot's highest role.

itemFields.label: XP reward
itemFields.description: Reward: XP. Needs the Levels module to be on.

itemFields.label: Coin reward
itemFields.description: Reward: coins. Needs the Economy module to be on.

fields.label: Count past activity
fields.description: Off: members start from zero when the achievement is created. Only applies to members who have no progress yet.

fields.label: Deadline
fields.description: The last moment members can make progress (between a minute and five years from now). Empty means no deadline.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off: nothing is counted until you turn it back on. Progress is kept.

readOnly.label: Members with progress
readOnly.description: How many members have started this achievement.

starboards.label: Starboards
starboards.description: Boards that repost popular messages to a channel. Deleting a board keeps its reposts, but they stop updating. The bot picks up changes within about a minute.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32). Unique on this server.
fields.patternMessage: The name may only use lowercase letters a-z, digits, - and _.

fields.label: Repost channel
fields.description: Where popular messages are reposted. Changing it reposts live entries into the new channel; old reposts stay where they are.

fields.label: Emojis that count
fields.description: Reactions that count towards the threshold: an emoji, or a custom emoji as <:name:id> or just its ID. Empty means every emoji counts.

fields.label: Reactions needed
fields.description: How many counting reactions a message needs to be reposted.

fields.label: Count the author's own reaction
fields.description: Off: a member reacting to their own message does not count.

fields.label: Remove the author's own reaction
fields.description: The bot removes a member's own qualifying reaction (needs Manage Messages). Cannot be combined with counting it.

fields.label: Ignore bots
fields.description: Ignore messages from bots and reactions by bots.

fields.label: Remove the repost below the threshold
fields.description: Delete the repost when the message falls below the threshold again.

fields.label: React to the repost
fields.description: The bot adds the first counting emoji to the repost (needs Add Reactions and Read Message History).

fields.label: Ignore older messages
fields.description: Messages older than this many days are never reposted. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Repost from age-restricted channels
fields.description: The repost channel must be age-restricted too.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Messages in these channels (or categories) never reach this board.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off: nothing is reposted by this board.

readOnly.label: Live reposts
readOnly.description: Messages this board currently has reposted.

translateChannels.label: Translated channels
translateChannels.description: Channels where the bot translates every message. Adding the first channel also turns the Auto-Translate module on, like /autotranslate does. Deleting a channel here only stops the translating. The bot picks up changes within about 30 seconds.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Messages posted here are translated by the bot. Text, announcement, voice and stage channels (their chat) work; threads are set up with /autotranslate in Discord.

fields.label: Translate into
fields.description: Up to five languages. Every message is translated into each of them (the bot posts a reply with the translations).

translateStats.label: Channels by translation activity
translateStats.description: Per channel: how many messages were translated (auto-translate replies and /translate), the languages members write in and the languages they were translated into. Only counts are kept, never the messages.

readOnly.label: Members write in
readOnly.description: The language of each translated message, as the translation service detected it.

tempVoiceHubs.label: Voice hubs
tempVoiceHubs.description: Join-to-create voice channels. Deleting a hub here only removes its settings and is refused while its temporary channels are open; the hub channel itself stays in Discord (use /voice-hub delete to remove channels too). The bot notices new, changed and deleted hubs within about 5 minutes.

fields.label: Hub channel
fields.description: The voice channel members join to get their own channel. Pick an existing voice channel; this page cannot create one (/voice-hub create can do that in Discord). It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Category for new channels
fields.description: Where the temporary channels are created. Empty uses the hub channel's own category.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: The name of each new channel. {index} is the channel number and {username} the owner's name. Mentions such as {user} are not allowed.

fields.label: User limit
fields.description: How many members fit in a new channel. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Bitrate
fields.description: Audio quality of new channels. Empty uses Discord's default. The server's boost level caps it.

fields.label: Keep empty channels
fields.description: How long an empty channel survives before it is deleted. 0 deletes it at once.

fields.label: Ownership lock
fields.description: How long after the owner leaves before someone else can claim the channel with /voice claim. 0 means at once.

fields.label: Copy the category's permissions
fields.description: On: new channels copy the category's permissions. Off: they copy the hub channel's.

fields.label: Create a text channel too
fields.description: Each new voice channel gets a companion text channel.

fields.label: Text channel only for voice members
fields.description: Only members currently in the voice channel can see its text channel.

fields.label: Protected roles
fields.description: /voice commands do not affect members with these roles: they cannot be kicked or banned, and locking or hiding does not shut them out.

fields.label: Moderator roles
fields.description: Members with these roles can use every /voice command on any channel from this hub.

readOnly.label: Open channels
readOnly.description: Temporary channels from this hub that exist right now.

statChannels.label: Counter channels
statChannels.description: Voice channels renamed about every 10 minutes to show a live number (members, online, boosts, ...). Discord allows only a few renames per channel, so a name can lag a few minutes. Deleting a counter here only stops the updates; the channel stays in Discord with its last name. Channels that /stats create makes (locked for @everyone) can be edited and deleted here.

fields.label: What to count
fields.description: The number the channel name shows. Cannot be changed later. Only the Online and Peak online counters need the bot to see presences.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: An existing voice channel that the bot renames. Pick a dedicated one: its name is replaced. Deny Connect for @everyone on it so nobody joins (/stats create in Discord does that for you). It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Role to count
fields.description: Only for "Role members": whose members are counted. The role is only counted, never given. Cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: The channel name; {count} is replaced by the number ({role} by the role name for "Role members"). Empty uses the default for the counter type, e.g. "Members: {count}".

readOnly.label: Showing
readOnly.description: The number in the channel name at the last update.

readOnly.label: Peak
readOnly.description: The highest online count seen (Peak online only).

actions.label: Update the counters now
actions.description: Asks the bot to update every counter channel of this server within about a minute (/stats refresh). Discord still limits how often a channel can be renamed, so a name can lag a few minutes. The Statistics Channels module must be on.

economyBoosts.label: Coin boosts
economyBoosts.description: A boost multiplies one /daily or /work payout for a member who holds its role (or for everyone). Only the highest boost a member has not used up in the current period applies. Rewards, /pay, casino winnings and admin grants are never boosted.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Bonus
fields.description: Extra coins in percent: 50 turns a payout of 100 coins into 150.

fields.label: How often one member can use it
fields.description: One-time: once per member, ever. The others: once per day, ISO week or month in the server time zone. Cannot be changed later; delete the boost and create a new one for that.

fields.label: Only members with this role
fields.description: Leave empty so every member qualifies. The role is only checked, never given.

fields.label: On
fields.description: A boost that is off is ignored. Its usage history is kept.

readOnly.label: Times used
readOnly.description: How many times members have used this boost so far.

cases.label: Moderation cases
cases.description: Every moderation action in this server, newest first. A new case warns, times out, kicks, softbans, bans or unbans someone exactly like the slash commands: the member gets a DM when that is on, the case is posted in the case log and warnings count towards your automatic punishments. Nothing is posted in a chat channel. Cases cannot be deleted; "Clear warnings" pardons all of a member's active warnings.
cases.searchPlaceholder: Search by member name, user ID or case number

fields.label: Action
fields.description: What to do. The same rules as the slash commands apply: your highest role must be above theirs and immune members are protected.

options.label: Warn
options.description: Records a warning and DMs the member (/warn). Warnings can trigger your automatic punishments.

options.label: Timeout
options.description: Times the member out (/timeout). Over 28 days uses the mute role, when one is set.

options.label: Remove timeout or mute
options.description: Removes the member's timeout and mute role (/unmute).

options.label: Kick
options.description: Kicks the member (/kick). They can rejoin with an invite.

options.label: Softban
options.description: Bans and immediately unbans to delete their recent messages (/softban).

options.label: Ban
options.description: Bans the user, also when they already left (/ban). Give a duration for a temporary ban.

options.label: Unban
options.description: Lifts a ban (/unban).

fields.label: Member
fields.description: Who to act on. Bans and unbans also work for users who are not in the server: paste their user ID.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Kept with the case, written to the audit log and sent in the DM. Required for a warning; up to 512 characters (1,000 when you edit it later, like /case reason).

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: How long, e.g. 10m, 2h, 7d or 1mo. A timeout needs one (over 28 days uses the mute role); leave it empty for a permanent ban.

fields.label: Delete their recent messages
fields.description: Days of their messages to delete, 0 to 7.

fields.label: Delete their recent messages
fields.description: Days of their messages to delete, 1 to 7.

fields.label: Proof link
fields.description: An http(s) link to evidence, kept with the case. It can be replaced later but not removed (like /case proof).

actions.label: Clear warnings
actions.description: Pardons all of this case's member's active warnings, like /case clear-history (administrators only). Their cases stay in the history, and escalation counting starts over.
actions.confirm: Pardon every active warning of this case's member? Their cases stay in the history.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why the warnings are cleared (kept in the pardon note).

levels.label: Member levels
levels.description: The XP leaderboard of this server. Give, remove or set XP and reset members like /levelconfig xp does: reward roles follow the new level and no level-up message is posted. This works while the Levels module is off. Giving XP to every member of a role is only available with /levelconfig xp give in Discord.
levels.searchPlaceholder: Search by member name or user ID

fields.label: Member
fields.description: The member who gets the XP. Bots never earn XP.

fields.label: XP to give
fields.description: Added to their total (at most 1,000,000 at a time). Reward roles follow the new level; no level-up message is posted.

actions.label: Give XP
actions.description: Adds XP to this member (like /levelconfig xp give).

fields.label: XP to give
fields.description: At most 1,000,000 at a time.

actions.label: Remove XP
actions.description: Takes XP from this member, never below 0 (like /levelconfig xp remove).

fields.label: XP to remove
fields.description: At most 1,000,000 at a time.

actions.label: Set XP
actions.description: Sets this member's total XP (like /levelconfig xp set).

actions.label: Reset XP
actions.description: Wipes this member's XP and level (like /levelconfig xp reset).
actions.confirm: Reset this member's XP and level to zero? This cannot be undone.

balances.label: Member balances
balances.description: Every member's coins on this server, richest first. Give, remove or set coins and reset members like /economy-admin does: balances never go above the server's maximum balance, and a member's first balance here starts from their old global balance unless that import is turned off. This works while the Economy module is off.
balances.searchPlaceholder: Search by member name or user ID

fields.label: Member
fields.description: Who gets the coins. Bots cannot hold coins.

fields.label: Coins to give
fields.description: Added to their balance, never above the server's maximum balance.

readOnly.label: Rank
readOnly.description: Members with the same balance share a rank.

actions.label: Give coins
actions.description: Adds coins to this member's balance (like /economy-admin coins give).

fields.label: Coins to give
fields.description: Never above the server's maximum balance.

actions.label: Remove coins
actions.description: Takes coins from this member, never below 0 (like /economy-admin coins remove).

fields.label: Coins to remove
fields.description: If they have fewer, their balance becomes 0.

actions.label: Set balance
actions.description: Sets this member's balance (like /economy-admin coins set).

fields.label: New balance
fields.description: From 0 to the server's maximum balance.

actions.label: Reset
actions.description: Resets this member's coins and/or items (like /economy-admin reset member:).

options.label: Coins
options.description: Their balance goes back to the starting balance; their daily streak and cooldowns are cleared.

options.label: Items
options.description: Every item in their inventory is removed. Shop items stay.

options.label: Coins and items
options.description: Both of the above.

giveaways.label: Giveaways
giveaways.description: Giveaways with a Participate button, the same as /giveaway in Discord. Running and draft ones come first, then the finished ones. Up to 100 can be running at once. Only the bonus odds can be changed after it is posted. Starting and ending run in the bot, so they can take a few seconds.

fields.label: Prize
fields.description: What the winners get. Shown as the title of the giveaway.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Extra text shown in the giveaway message. Optional.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the giveaway is posted. The bot needs to view the channel and send messages, embeds and message history there.

fields.label: Winners
fields.description: How many winners are drawn, 1 to 90.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: How long it runs, like 30m, 2h, 3d or 1w (1 minute to 90 days). Fill in this or the end time, not both.

fields.label: End time
fields.description: Or the exact moment it ends (up to 90 days away). Fill in this or the length, not both.

fields.label: Required roles
fields.description: Members must have all of these roles to enter. Leave empty for everyone.

fields.label: Blocked roles
fields.description: Members with any of these roles cannot enter.

fields.label: Bonus odds
fields.description: Members with one of these roles count as several entries when the winners are drawn (the highest matching role counts). This is the one thing you can still change while a giveaway is running or in drafts.

itemFields.label: Entries
itemFields.description: How many entries each member of the role counts as.

fields.label: XP for each winner
fields.description: Paid out through the Levels module when the giveaway ends. Needs that module to be on.

fields.label: Coins for each winner
fields.description: Paid out through the Economy module when the giveaway ends. Needs that module to be on.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned when the giveaway is posted. The role must be mentionable, or the bot and you need Mention @everyone, @here and All Roles in the channel.

fields.label: Colour
fields.description: Colour of the giveaway message while it runs. Empty: the server colour.

actions.label: End now
actions.description: Draws the winners now, announces them and pays the XP and coin prizes. Same as /giveaway end.
actions.confirm: End this giveaway now and draw its winners?

actions.label: Reroll
actions.description: Draws new winners of an ended giveaway. Earlier winners keep their prize. Same as /giveaway reroll.

fields.label: New winners
fields.description: How many more winners to draw.

actions.label: Restart
actions.description: Posts a draft giveaway (its message was deleted) again. The entries are kept. Same as /giveaway restart.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where to post it again. Empty: the original channel.

fields.label: New length
fields.description: Like 30m, 2h or 3d. Leave both empty to keep the old end time (needs at least a minute left).

fields.label: New end time
fields.description: Or the exact moment it ends. Use either this or the length.

actions.label: Cancel giveaway
actions.description: Stops a running or draft giveaway without drawing winners. Same as /giveaway cancel.
actions.confirm: Cancel this giveaway? No winners will be drawn and this cannot be undone.

polls.label: Polls
polls.description: Polls with vote buttons or a menu, the same as /poll in Discord. Active ones come first, then the finished ones. Up to 50 can be active at once. A posted poll cannot be edited. Posting and ending run in the bot, so they can take a few seconds.

fields.label: Question
fields.description: Shown as the title of the poll.

fields.label: Options
fields.description: 2 to 20 answers, each up to 80 characters. Members vote with a button (one choice) or a menu (several choices).

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the poll is posted. The bot needs to view the channel and send messages and embeds there.

fields.label: Choices per member
fields.description: 1: one answer per member (buttons). More: each member can pick up to that many answers (a menu). It is lowered to the number of options when there are fewer.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: How long it runs, like 30m, 2h or 3d (1 minute to 30 days). Empty: until someone ends it.

fields.label: Only these roles can vote
fields.description: Leave empty so everyone can vote.

fields.label: These roles cannot vote
fields.description: Members with any of these roles cannot vote, even if they also have an allowed role.

fields.label: Hide results until it ends
fields.description: Members see no counts while the poll is active. You can always see them here.

actions.label: End now
actions.description: Closes the poll and posts the results in its channel. Same as /poll end.
actions.confirm: End this poll now and post the results?

reactionRoles.label: Reaction role panels
reactionRoles.description: Saving a panel posts it in its channel or updates its message, and deleting it deletes the message too. Panels made with /reactionrole attach stay attached: the bot never edits or deletes their message.

fields.label: Template
fields.description: Start from a ready-made panel. A template creates its roles for you (or reuses ones with the same name); edit the panel afterwards to remove the ones you do not need.

options.label: Pronouns (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) He/Him, She/Her, They/Them, Any Pronouns, Ask My Pronouns and posts them as a Normal button panel.

options.label: Colors (10 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Light Blue, Blue, Purple, Pink, Brown, Grey and posts them as a Unique dropdown.

options.label: Age groups (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) 13-17, 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45+ and posts them as a Unique button panel.

options.label: Regions (7 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Middle East, Asia, Oceania and posts them as a Unique button panel.

options.label: Gaming platforms (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Mobile and posts them as a Normal button panel.

options.label: DM status (3 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) DMs Open, Ask to DM, DMs Closed and posts them as a Unique button panel.

options.label: Ping roles (5 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) Announcements, Events, Giveaways, Polls, Streams and posts them as a Normal button panel.

options.label: Timezones: US (10 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) SST, HST, AKST, PST, MST (AZ), MST, CST, EST, AST (PR), ChST, links each to its time zone for /timestamp, and posts them as a Unique dropdown.

options.label: Timezones: worldwide (24 roles)
options.description: Creates (or reuses) HST, AKST, PST, MST (AZ), MST, CST (MX), CST, EST, AST (PR), AST, BRT, GMT, CET, EET, MSK, GST, PKT, IST, ICT, SGT, JST, ChST, AEST, NZST, links each to its time zone for /timestamp, and posts them as a Unique dropdown.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the panel is posted. Use "Repost" to move it later.

fields.label: Layout
fields.description: How members pick roles.

fields.label: Role mode
fields.description: Normal: get and remove roles. Unique: one role at a time. Verify: get roles only. Reverse: using a role removes it.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The heading of the panel (up to 256 characters).

fields.label: Text under the title
fields.description: Shown in the embed under the title. Empty: a default text for the layout.

fields.label: Message text
fields.description: Plain text sent with the panel, up to 2000 characters.

fields.label: Text only (no embed)
fields.description: Send the panel as plain text instead of an embed.

fields.label: Most roles per member
fields.description: Normal mode only. Empty: no limit.

fields.label: Dropdown placeholder
fields.description: Dropdown panels only: the text shown before a member picks, up to 150 characters. Empty: a default.

fields.label: Roles
fields.description: In this order. Buttons and dropdowns hold up to 25 roles, emoji reactions up to 20. Roles with moderator or admin permissions can only be added with /reactionrole add in Discord, which asks you to confirm.
fields.emptyText: No roles yet. Add the roles members can pick.

itemFields.label: Role
itemFields.description: The role members get, below the bot's highest role and yours.

itemFields.label: Label
itemFields.description: Button text or dropdown label, up to 80 characters. Empty: the role name.

itemFields.label: Emoji
itemFields.description: Required on emoji-reaction panels (each emoji once). A standard emoji or one of this server's emojis.

itemFields.label: Button colour
itemFields.description: Button panels only.

itemFields.label: Dropdown description
itemFields.description: Dropdown panels only, up to 100 characters.

readOnly.label: Status
readOnly.description: Posted, not posted yet (use "Repost"), message deleted in Discord (use "Repost"), or an attached message.

actions.label: Repost
actions.description: Posts the panel again, in another channel or after its message was deleted, and deletes the old message. An attached panel without a channel only gets its reactions back.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: A text or announcement channel the bot can post in. Empty: the panel's own channel.

ticketPanels.label: Ticket panels
ticketPanels.description: Saving a panel updates its published message, and deleting it deletes the message too (open tickets keep their channels). Publishing, categories, the transcript channel and manager roles need the bot to be online.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A name for this panel, unique on the server (up to 50 characters).

fields.label: Style
fields.description: Members open a ticket with buttons or with a dropdown menu.

fields.label: Publish in channel
fields.description: Where the panel message is posted; pick another channel to move it. Empty: not published yet.

fields.label: Panel message
fields.description: The message with the buttons or dropdown. Link buttons are not used here. Empty: the default "How can we help?".

embed.title: How can we help?
embed.description: Press a button below to open a private ticket with our team.

fields.label: Options
fields.description: The buttons or dropdown entries, in this order. A panel keeps at least one.

itemFields.label: Label
itemFields.description: The button text or dropdown entry, up to 80 characters. Each label once per panel.

itemFields.label: Emoji
itemFields.description: A standard emoji or one of this server's custom emojis.

itemFields.label: Dropdown description
itemFields.description: Dropdown panels only, up to 100 characters.

itemFields.label: Button colour
itemFields.description: Button panels only.

itemFields.label: Category for this option
itemFields.description: Tickets of this option open here. Empty: the panel's open category.

itemFields.label: Intro message for this option
itemFields.description: Posted in tickets of this option. Empty: the panel's intro message.

itemFields.label: Option ID
itemFields.description: Internal. Identifies an existing option when you edit the list.

fields.label: Ticket manager roles
fields.description: Roles that can see and handle this panel's tickets (moderators and admins always can). Existing tickets get access too.

fields.label: Ticket intro message
fields.description: Posted when a ticket opens, with Close and Claim buttons. {managers} pings the manager roles. Empty: the default intro.

embed.title: Ticket #{number}
embed.description:
